news.title: Jyoti Structures Limited Appoints Amit Dutta as Chief Operating Officer
news.body: Jyoti Structures Limited has appointed Amit Dutta as its Chief Operating Officer. In his role as COO, Amit will oversee operations within JSL's EPC portfolio. Amit brings 36 years of experience in the transmission and distribution sector, spanning business development, tendering, project execution, and contract management with cost and time control. Prior to rejoining Jyoti Structures, Amit spent over six years with another company in the sector as Senior Vice President, where he led EPC transmission projects in the Africa region, as well as some North and South American countries. This appointment marks Amit's second stint with Jyoti Structures, with his association with the company spanning nearly three decades, beginning in 1991.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.6% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent.
